technical.summary: Strong short-term momentum with overbought conditions and exceptional volume spike, but extended price action and lack of long-term trend confirmation limit swing entry probability.

fundamental.summary: VTR shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and faces elevated volatility risk with earnings 9 days away.

sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal; mixed congressional activity from junior member in small amounts, neutral market sentiment, and absent news data provide insufficient conviction for directional bias.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (181), FOMC event in 1 day, and earnings binary in 9 days create compounded event risk for real estate sector.

debate.key_bull_argument: Exceptional 15x volume spike with Donchian 20 new high and stochastic bullish cross provide short-term momentum confirmation for swing entry near support.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought RSI conditions, macro crisis environment (VIX 181, inverted yield curve, FOMC in 1 day), earnings binary in 9 days, zero fundamental conviction, and price below both 50/200 EMAs create compounded event risk that overwhelms technical momentum.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical momentum (15x volume spike, DC20 new high, stoch cross) offers short-term swing setup, but overbought conditions and price positioning near resistance limit entry quality.
decision.primary_risk: Compounded event risk from FOMC in 1 day, earnings binary in 9 days, VIX crisis levels (181), and inverted yield curve create severe macro headwinds that can gap through technical levels.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
decision.portfolio_note: Existing VTR position plus 44 open Real Estate positions create sector concentration; skip entry to reduce redundant exposure in unfavourable macro environment.
